profile.name: Guillem Soler Suetta
profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer (Go/Java) | Fintech: Payments, Tokenization, Credit | Event‑Driven, AWS, Kubernetes | Reliability & Low‑Latency APIs
profile.about:
I’m a Senior Backend Engineer (~10 years) specializing in Go and Java, building event‑driven microservices and low‑latency APIs for fintech and e‑commerce. I design for correctness and reliability first—idempotency, outbox/SAGA, SLIs/SLOs—on AWS and Kubernetes, backed by PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Kafka, and Redis. My focus is turning messy financial data into correct, observable, and scalable systems.

Recently at Actus AG, I built backend services and automations that transform banking data and streamline accounting workflows; designed resilient APIs and jobs with idempotency and retries; and developed pipelines to normalize blockchain/Web3 transactions for tax/reporting, including reconciliation and FX handling. I also drove Terraform‑based cloud automation, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and observability with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

Previously at HelloFresh, I delivered customer and platform services (.NET/C#, React) with PostgreSQL and Kafka integrations; operated services on Kubernetes with Docker, Helm, and GitOps (Flux); and contributed Terraform and CI/CD to reduce lead time and improve rollout safety. Earlier, I shipped B2B features at Wolters Kluwer (Java/Spring and .NET with Angular, on Azure) and built real‑time GPS tracking for ambulance fleets at Oxigen Salud.

I’m looking for senior backend roles in fintech—payments, credit/authorization, tokenization, and ledgers—where reliability, security (PCI awareness, KMS/Secrets, audit logging), and strong engineering practices matter. Based in Buenos Aires (GMT‑3). Open to remote roles in Europe and the US.

Let’s connect if you’re scaling Go/Java services and want pragmatic, production‑minded engineering.
